note: Complaints from public 1-3 star reviews and public comments. Paraphrased in our words, no reviewer names. Reddit and Amazon could not be read from the cloud (blocked), so they are not in here yet. Counts are only what we found, not market totals. Rival-only pass 2026-10-17: Etsy shop and listing pages show only top reviews (all 5 stars seen), Payhip/Gumroad/Thatch show no reviews, so digital rivals have almost no public complaints to read; most rival complaints are about the two pole brands and one park-guide seller. 2026-10-22 pass: winter gear (headlamps, gloves, gaiters) for the headlamp now in store and the plan's cold-weather focus; Etsy digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews. 2026-10-27 pass: the two group-A gear benchmarks (Cascade Mountain Tech poles, Darn Tough socks) from OutdoorGearLab, Trustpilot, REI, review blogs and a hiking forum; Etsy digital rivals still show only 5-star reviews.
